name: John Vrsalovich
office: Foothill Municipal Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 2

items.text: John Vrsalovich was appointed to the Foothill Municipal Water District Board of Directors for Division 2 in July 2023. He holds degrees in civil engineering, manages construction contracts at the Metropolitan Water District of Southern California, and has served on the Rubio Cañon Land and Water Association board for nearly 20 years. His campaign says he focuses on reliable water service, fire recovery, and careful spending.
